task.description:
Design Epic 4 compensation and restore reconciliation work for EXP-401 and EXP-402.

Deliver a prose design artefact that covers:
- compensation handler and error-boundary node types
- engine recording of compensation as first-class events
- graph validation of handler reachability and reversibility
- restore reconciliation using wait descriptors
- how EXP-402 depends on EXP-103 wait descriptors

Keep the design implementation-free, precise enough for BACKEND-DEV and TEST-DESIGNER to proceed.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all MUST acceptance criteria for EXP-401 and EXP-402

result.summary: Design for compensation and restore reconciliation — types: [E]
